name: DJ Crossfader With Peak Meters
tags: dj, crossfader, mixer, meters, drag, inertia, peak hold, audio
note: Throw the fader and let go — it keeps travelling and bounces off the end stops. Both deck meters run a simulated beat envelope with fast attack, slow release and a falling peak-hold segment; the constant-power / sharp-cut curve button changes the gain law under your hand. Double-click re-centres with a spring.

name: Jog Wheel With Momentum
tags: jog wheel, turntable, platter, momentum, inertia, spin, drag, dj
note: Grab the platter and throw it: angular velocity is sampled from the pointer and integrated with torque and friction, so it keeps spinning and glides back to 33⅓ rpm. The strobe ring turns at the difference between actual and nominal speed, so it freezes when you are exactly on pitch — the same trick as the dots on a real deck.

name: Tap Tempo With Ripple Rings
tags: bpm, tap tempo, metronome, ripple, beat, timing, tempo
note: Tap the pad (pointer, Space or Enter) at least twice: intervals are averaged with outlier rejection, the readout eases toward the new tempo instead of snapping, and each tap fires a ripple ring that cleans itself up on animationend. Between taps a metronome phase drives the four beat lamps and the pad's breathing pulse.

name: Rotary Drive Knob
tags: knob, rotary, drag, gauge, arc, ticks, fling, spring, effect
note: Drag up or down anywhere on the dial — the classic DAW gesture — and flick to fling: the release velocity keeps the value moving and bounces off the end stops with a damped spring. The arc uses pathLength so one dasharray write draws it, the tick ring lights with a staggered sweep, and the LED comet chases faster as drive rises.

name: 16-Pad Grid With Bloom Decay
tags: pads, mpc, drum, grid, canvas, particles, sequencer, velocity, decay
note: A 16-step sequencer runs from mount, so pads fire on their own. Hit a pad (click, Space or Enter) to trigger it and arm or disarm it in the running bar. Each hit sets a level that decays exponentially every frame while a canvas layer blooms an additive ring and sparks from the pad centre.
